title: Franchesco
description: "The wonder and excitement of the STAR WARS trilogy still has the ability to bring out the little kid in me," reveals Franchesco. "Although R2-D2 and C-3PO were not made up of flesh and blood, they are just as real as the rest of their stellar cast. This allowed me as the viewer to participate in all of that glorious action through the various characters, including the robots." Franchesco has co-created and illustrated ADAM for DC's GREEN LANTERN CORPS and THE SCAVENGERS for Triumphant. He is currently creating the visuals to SCHIZM for Marvel's "Barkerverse."
